$description: Source for the v2 colour system. scripts/generate-palettes.mjs reads this file and writes tokens/palette.json, tokens/color.json and tokens/color.dark.json. Edit this file, never the generated ones. Seeds are OKLAB [L, a, b]; each palette keeps the seed's OKLCH hue and scales the seed's chroma by the curve below, then every tone is solved for exact luminance (tone = CIELAB L*). See docs/v2/foundations.md.

chromaCurve.$description: Multiplier of the seed chroma at each tone. Light tones carry less chroma so containers stay calm; the curve is the average of direction E's channel ramps.

neutral.description: Cool grey with a trace of city indigo (hue 275). Replaces direction E's neutrals, whose trace hue (163-194) sat in the teal band.

indigo.description: City indigo, the shared primary. Seed is direction E's primary-40 exactly (tone 31.9).

now.description: Dubai Now, blue. Seed: E now-40.

transport.description: Dubai Transport, rust. Seed: E transport-40.

visit.description: Visit Dubai, magenta. Seed: E visit-40.

justice.description: Dubai Justice, violet. Seed: E justice-40.

build.description: Build in Dubai, ochre. Seed: E build-40. Light tones keep more chroma, as in E, so 80 and 90 read yellow rather than beige.

invest.description: Invest in Dubai, green. Seed: E invest-40. Light tones keep more chroma, as in E.

trade.description: Dubai Trade, slate. Seed: E trade-40 (tone 35.2). Low-chroma seed, so light tones keep proportionally more chroma.

tint-blue.description: Decorative topic tint: transport, vehicles, travel. Hue from v1 feat/tint-palette.

tint-violet.description: Decorative topic tint: residency, visas, identity.

tint-rose.description: Decorative topic tint: family, social support, people.

tint-orange.description: Decorative topic tint: housing, utilities, home.

tint-amber.description: Decorative topic tint: bills, money, payments due.

roles.$description: System roles: [palette, light tone, dark tone, use].
surface-card: Cards, fields, list groups, dialogs and sheets
surface-container: Bands, panels, table headers, totals rows
surface-container-high: A container nested in a container; skeletons
outline: Control boundaries (1.5px) and inactive markers; at least 3:1
outline-strong: Hovered control edges, the sign-in edge and the plate chip; at least 3:1
outline-variant: Dividers and card edges only; never the only edge of a control
on-disabled: Text, icons and edges of a disabled control
focus-ring: The 3px focus ring, drawn outside a 2px gap of surface
primary: City indigo: the network strip, sign-in and Dubai Pay hand-offs
error: Error text, icons, field edges and destructive fills
on-error: Text and icons on an error fill
error-container: Error summary, error chip and callout background
success: Success text and icons; completed step markers
on-success: Text and icons on a success fill
on-warning: Text and icons on a warning fill
on-info: Text and icons on an info fill
on-tint-blue: Icon and short text on the tile
on-tint-violet: Icon and short text on the tile
on-tint-rose: Icon and short text on the tile
on-tint-orange: Icon and short text on the tile
on-tint-amber: Icon and short text on the tile
on-tint-green: Icon and short text on the tile
channel-on-action: Text and icons on any channel action fill (the same in every channel)

alphaRoles.$description: Translucent roles: [OKLAB light, alpha light, OKLAB dark, alpha dark, use].
shadow: Base shadow colour; elevation layers set their own alpha

channels.$description: Each channel's palette and the tone of its action colour. Hover and pressed are the action tone minus 5 and minus 10. Trade keeps E's deeper slate (35) because a tone-40 slate reads as grey.

channelRoles.$description: Per-channel roles: [light tone (or offset from the action tone), dark tone, use].
action: Buttons, links, selected states, the current step, progress
container: Selected navigation item, chips on a tinted card
subtle: Hero band, tinted rows, the halo of the current step
outline: 1px edges on suggestion chips and outlined channel chips (decorative, no contrast pair)
